what: When the thin line under the small label above the section heading enters the screen, after .3s it is drawn in two pieces: the label-width part in the second color (power2.in), then the rest in the accent color (power2.out). The two pieces split a total of 1s by their width ratio on the line. At the same .3s the heading’s first line slides in from below (160%) and the second from above (-100%), .6s ease-out. Plays once only

options.start: Start position (ScrollTrigger start), default top bottom — with no header and only lines, top 90%
options.delay: Wait before the lines and title start (s), default .3
options.total: Total length (sec) of the two split lines, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=rule]: Horizontal row (child). Inside it [data-fx-part=rule-label] Label text
options.[data-fx-part=rise-line]: Title line rising from below — pushes one inner child
options.[data-fx-part=drop-line]: Title line coming down from above — pushes one inner child
options.--fx-first: Label underline color (via style), default var(--kf-accent-text)
options.--fx-rest: Color of the remaining lines (via style), default var(--kf-accent)
